title: label vertices and edges
explanation:
### Description

This example labels vertices of an undirected graph. Vertices are labelled with integer IDs (yellow) using a circular layout strategy. Edge weights are stored but vertex labels are the primary display.

**dataset → input → layout → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → output**

- [vtkCircularLayoutStrategy](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCircularLayoutStrategy.html) arranges vertices in a circle.
- [vtkDoubleArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDoubleArray.html) stores per-edge weight values.
- [vtkGraphLayout](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGraphLayout.html) applies the circular layout strategy.
- [vtkGraphToPolyData](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGraphToPolyData.html) converts graph edges to polydata lines.
- [vtkIntArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkIntArray.html) stores per-vertex ID values.
- [vtkLabeledDataMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkLabeledDataMapper.html) renders vertex labels as yellow text.
- [vtkMutableUndirectedGraph](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkMutableUndirectedGraph.html) builds the undirected graph.
